scope: Durable runtime-settings receipts, tab-local raw drafts, explicit conflict resolution, read-only save lookup, same-ID/original-payload retry, and form/scope ownership for asynchronous reads, saves and current model selections.
prior_behavior: Runtime configuration had a revision check, but no save receipt or draft recovery. Saving/reloading applied async responses to shared state without form ownership. Runtime model directory completion reused a selection captured before the request.

backend.implementation: An additive runtime_configuration_requests table stores immutable accepted settings. Request acceptance and configuration revision commit in the same SQLite transaction. Lookup reads current configuration with its receipt snapshot and never invokes cognition. Legacy request bodies remain supported.

frontend.fixture_adjustment: The minimal DOM fixture gained focus methods after keyboard restoration was added. The initial focused-control failures were fixture capability errors, not browser failures.

iterations.note: Real browser exposed duplicate change on input blur rebuilding the recovery control before its click completed. Equal raw input now returns without rendering; a regression test covers that boundary.

All functional and layout checks passed. Final evidence adds two animation frames before capture to avoid a transient compositor artifact during theme/viewport/scroll changes; application source unchanged.

browser.visual_review: Inspected final light/dark recovery and conflict views, exact prior submission disclosure, current configuration table, explicit adopt/keep controls and disabled unreviewed save. Eight cases verify 1024/1440 widths, normal/28px recovery text, visible focus and bounds, with no horizontal panel overflow.
browser.isolation: Temporary runtime configuration and synthetic model catalog. Browser simulates accepted-but-lost receipt, unsent request, later competing saves, navigation during pending save, edits during slow reload and choices during model refresh. No real model, CLI detection or business operation; no host runtime configuration changed.

limits: Drafts are browser-tab-local and are not a server-backed shared settings draft. Closing the browser can remove them.
Storage errors retain only page memory and expose selectable configuration text for copying.
Late request guards do not cancel a configuration save already running on the server; the saved request ID remains the recovery authority.
Configuration remains tenant-wide across workspaces, while receipts are scoped to tenant and principal.
Legacy clients without request_id retain revision-check semantics, not receipt-based idempotency.
Creating an agent uses saved configuration; local unsaved settings remain a separate draft.
Saved configuration does not alter frozen settings of existing tasks or prove model availability or CLI authorization.
Local candidates remain version 1.3.0 and are not published; fresh installation was not repeated.
